Ichijou caught her breath. Apparently military expertise was not needed to understand this much bad news.

I wanted to curse. Instead I turned my thinking toward something constructive. Depends how you look at it, people say. Achha, then look properly.

A replacement warrior was a serious disadvantage, yes. But the changeover would show where the human sat inside the enemy unit—the very thing I needed to know. Know that, and I could use Ending, the Railgun, against it.

How much power could I produce with the heat reserve scraping bottom? That problem remained. Still, here was our only chance.

I concentrated everything on seeing.

I stood. Excellent. Hatred was strength.

So much hatred, and I could stand.
So much hatred, and I could move.

The burns in my leg sent up a savage pain.
...Not enough.

Every movement made the armor drink from my life, bringing pain as though my organs were being wrung out.
...Not enough.

Not enough.
Not enough.
Bilkul nahin. Not nearly enough.

More wounds. More curses.
For him, more. More.

                Suffer.

One step and my knee buckled, shaking as though it were laughing.

What a pitiful display. Limbs that move, you still have those.

                Suffer.

One step and my sight swam. Consciousness blurred; sensation grew uncertain.

Look at you. Still able to see. Still able to hear.

                Murderer.

Think of those who lost all that.
Socho. Think.

Those from whom you took it.
Think of them.

Ah.

        Kageaki Minato.
        May this agony torment you for all eternity.
        May it never let you go.

He was not burning with eagerness for battle.

Battle was duty. Work. Always work. Not some passionate exercise in discovering the meaning of his existence. A role had been given; he performed it. Bas.

The colleague who had piloted Arahabaki until just now was different. That fellow enjoyed fighting. Savored it, even.

What enjoyment was available here? However thick the armor, receiving bullets was frightening. Sending bullets into someone else was not free of disgust either. From either end, an unpleasant business.

He had watched his colleague's entire fight against the crimson warrior. A rare, worthy opponent, yes, he understood that. He was not a born warrior. Rare quality in the enemy did not make his day better.

He wanted to return to his wife and children. Quickly. That was all he wished for on a battlefield.

So when he finally found the enemy, fear and relief moved through his chest together, cold and warm. Skin prickling, heartbeat settling. Both at once.

...Ah.
The unpleasant work had finally begun.

...Finish this, then home...

A red flicker appeared at the edge of his monitor. He sighed once and got on with operating the giant soldier.

en.html:
Justice may be humanity's great road. That does not mean the human mind naturally wants to travel it.

Wear justice as a costume over selfishness, and you are comparatively healthy. Costume can be removed. Make it your flesh and bones instead, carve it into yourself like an instinct—that is a mind grown into a strange shape.

The ancients said: great works are not done in sanity.
Another said: love the mad fool. Be the madman.

They understood. Remove self-interest entirely, and true justice has only madness left to stand on. Sanity is not offering that much support.

Ichijou Ayane differed from them. Before knowing any of this, she was already living it.

Perhaps more purely than they had. More directly.
More rightly than anyone—mad.

Shoot, shoot. At the enemy running between the trees. More than ten minutes of this already.

No return attack. Not even an attempt to fly. The earlier fight must have emptied it completely.

Still it would not give up. Irritation, impatience, nausea. All were coming.

        ...Ah.
        Finish quickly. Please.

Wishing it with his whole heart, he swept the machine guns. One vertical line. The red shadow escaped with only a slight hit.

        Mujhe ghar jaana hai. I want to go home.

Disgust and impatience burned in him. He swept along its escape route. No hit. Only trees fell, leaving another vertical line through the forest.

        Jaldi. Quickly—

Stress brought acid up from his stomach. Bitter, much too bitter. He forced it down.

Turn the unit. Sweep again. Across the two vertical lines, one horizontal strip of bare ground. Three sides.

        Nahin. No more of this—

No enemy in sight. The red figure had not crossed any of those cleared lines, where nothing could hide it.

He turned and fired again. The last line.

Ahead blocked, a shadow hurried back. He caught a glimpse of it going inside the square.

Square.
Four lines of bare earth, cut through the trees by his guns.
The enemy was inside.

        ...Ah.
        ...Finally...

Once he understood how difficult it was to chase one ground soldier with this giant, he had endured and waited. Now, at last, the opening.

The acid rose again. This time he spat it at his feet.

        ...Finally this will end.

He gathered himself and activated Arahabaki's Divine Art. Of little use against a warrior protected by armor.

Heat deprivation.

Every tree inside the square died in an instant.

Nothing remained to hide behind. In the clearing, the red figure stood still, apparently stunned.

        ...Now I can go home.

　敵はその中にいる。

　この巨騎をもって地上の一兵を追う事がいかに困難
か理解してから、耐えに耐え、待ちに待っていた機会

　彼はぶり返した胃液を足元に吐き散らした。

　もはや身を隠す何物もない空き地のなか。
　赤い姿が呆けた様子で、立ち尽くしている。

　
　　　　　　　　……これで、帰れる。

Kanae"Actually making it quiet may be a little harder than announcing it, no?"
Kageaki"............"
Ichijou"Arre, what... That much trouble? Looking at it, yes, obviously, but still."
Kanae"Not merely an impressive appearance. A cannon without shells, a barrier apparently produced by a strong magnetic field, rounds that chase their target—remote control or heat-seeking, perhaps..."
Kanae"Whatever its state of completion, the latest technology is packed into that monster. Honestly, one warrior against it seems a rather unreasonable arrangement..."
Ichijou"...Wait. Cannon without shells? What bakwas machinery is that?"
Kanae"I do not know. Something was certainly being sent out instead of shells."
Kanae"Kageaki. Left arm, right leg, then left leg—that cannon hit all three, did it not? What damage?"
Kageaki"Nothing exceptional."
Kanae"Your left hand and foot no longer move. That much is already visible."
Kageaki"............"
Sayo"...Now it fits. Burned, Mr. Minato."
Sayo"This unusual smell has been troubling my nose for some time."
Kageaki"...Somewhat."
Sayo"If memory serves, that smell comes from being burned through to the marrow in an instant. Movement would naturally be difficult."
Ichijou"...!!"
Kageaki"No serious concern. The tsurugi's healing will restore it in time."
Kanae"Before that time comes, however, you intend to fight again? You believe you can win?"
Kageaki"Some prospect exists."
Kanae"How many chances in ten?"
Ichijou"Hey..."
Kageaki"Approximately ten."
Kanae"............"
Kageaki"A toy of that sort is not permitted to kill me so easily. My body appears to have certain inconveniences at present."
Kageaki"Irrelevant. I shall bring the enemy unit down."
Sayo"............"
Ichijou"Is that... because it's right?"
Kageaki"No. A much, much pettier matter. If dying is not permitted, then I have to crush the enemy and survive. There is no other road."
Kageaki"Bas. That is all."
Ichijou"............"
Kanae"...Understood. But Kageaki—"
Kanae"This insistence on continuing against that monster—is it because—"
Muramasa《Mido. Movement around the enemy unit.》

I stood. Excellent. Hatred was strength.

So much hatred, and I could stand.
So much hatred, and I could move.

The burns in my leg sent up a savage pain.
...Not enough.

Every movement made the armor drink from my life, bringing pain as though my organs were being wrung out.
...Not enough.

Not enough.
Not enough.
Bilkul nahin. Not nearly enough.

More wounds. More curses.
For him, more. More.

                Suffer.

One step and my knee buckled, shaking as though it were laughing.

What a pitiful display. Limbs that move, you still have those.

                Suffer.

One step and my sight swam. Consciousness blurred; sensation grew uncertain.

Look at you. Still able to see. Still able to hear.

                Murderer.

Think of those who lost all that.
Socho. Think.

Those from whom you took it.
Think of them.

Ah.

        Kageaki Minato.
        May this agony torment you for all eternity.
        May it never let you go.

俺は立ち上がった。
　素晴らしい。憎悪こそは力だ。

　こんなにも憎いから動ける。

　脚の火傷が猛痛を放った。
　……足りない。

　身動きする都度、よろう甲鉄が俺の命を吸い、内臓
を絞られるが如き苦痛を呼ぶ。
　……足りない。

　足りぬ、
　足りぬ、
　まるで足りぬ。

　もっと傷が必要だ。
　もっと呪いが必要だ。
　奴にはもっと。もっと。


　
　　　　　　　　　　　苦しめ。

　一歩進むと、膝が折れた。
　かくかくと笑っている。

　惨めがましい。
　まだお前には、動く手足があるくせに。


　
　　　　　　　　　　　苦しめ。

　一歩進むと、目が眩んだ。
　意識が霞み、感覚が曖昧になる。

　憐れがましい。
　お前はまだ、物を見て音を聞くことができるくせに。

　それを失くした人々のことを想え。

　ああ。

　　　決して解放せぬように。

Kanae"True. Never mind. Let us NOT unite our strength! Everybody independently throw it at the mighty enemy!"

I stood. Excellent. Hatred was strength.

So much hatred, and I could stand.
So much hatred, and I could move.

The burns in my leg sent up a savage pain.
...Not enough.

Every movement made the armor drink from my life, bringing pain as though my organs were being wrung out.
...Not enough.

Not enough.
Not enough.
Bilkul nahin. Not nearly enough.

More wounds. More curses.
For him, more. More.

                Suffer.

One step and my knee buckled, shaking as though it were laughing.

What a pitiful display. Limbs that move, you still have those.

                Suffer.

One step and my sight swam. Consciousness blurred; sensation grew uncertain.

Look at you. Still able to see. Still able to hear.

                Murderer.

Think of those who lost all that.
Socho. Think.

Those from whom you took it.
Think of them.

Ah.

        Kageaki Minato.
        May this agony torment you for all eternity.
        May it never let you go.

俺は立ち上がった。
　素晴らしい。憎悪こそは力だ。

　こんなにも憎いから動ける。

　……足りない。

　身動きする都度、よろう甲鉄が俺の命を吸い、内臓

　……足りない。

　もっと呪いが必要だ。
　奴にはもっと。もっと。

　弾かれるものはどこで撃ってもまず弾かれる筈だ。

　鍛鉄繊維の電源ケーブルは甲鉄に比べればまだしも
脆弱だろうが、ライフル狙撃程度で屈するかといえば、
それは大いに疑問だった。
　加えて、不利な条件は他にもある。

　通常の武者に比べればはるかに鈍足とはいえ、あの
巨兵も騎航しているのだ。ケーブルはそれに合わせて、
同じ速度で飛遊している。
　……そんなものを狙撃できるのか？

　大尉の視力がいかに卓抜していようと、それで済む
問題ではない。
　予知能力でも持ち合わせていなくては不可能な事と
思える。

　現実と必要条件との隔たりに、あの女性将校はどう
整合をつけるつもりなのか。
　できもしない事を安請け合いする人間とは思えない
が……この状況では信用すべき要素が無さ過ぎた。

　あてにせず、こちらで方策を練った方が良いだろう。
　村正の太刀でなら、鍛鉄繊維であろうと切れる。

　障害となるのは、あの磁気の防壁だ。
　あれごと斬り破るには電磁抜刀を用いる以外にない。

　しかしその後、敵騎の甲鉄を裂いて仕手ユーザーを引き摺り
出すのにも蒐窮の太刀は要る。
　多大な熱量を消費する電磁抜刀、その二撃目は果た
して、あの重甲を貫徹するだけの威力に達するか――

Kanae Ootori hated the evil of this world.

No special incident had taught her to do so. Born noble, one acquired that much grounding as a matter of course.

Blood commanded you to rule? Then lead the world rightly. Be an example to the people. When evil disturbed that world, go first and destroy it. On those terms, and only those terms, noble standing was guaranteed.

Waste wealth and power on luxury and pleasure, or sing of righteous war while sending soldiers out and sitting safely in your palace—why should the people give you reverence and service? For what work, exactly?

The storms of Revolution had destroyed many such people. Nothing mysterious. Nothing unjust. Termites had occupied the house; the house was cleared of them.

Duty forgotten, rights devoured. Such a noble was only a parasite with a pedigree.

Therefore—

Of the Ootori blood, a house of ancient Shakuten lineage; eldest daughter of Tokitsugu Ootori, General of the Right Imperial Guard, Junior Third Rank, Taima no Mahito—Kanae hated the evils that harmed the world. And she would destroy them.

大鳥香奈枝はこの世の悪を憎悪する。

　何か格別の契機があったわけではない。
　貴種に生まれついた人間として、それは当然の素養
だった。

　人を支配すべく血統に命じられた者は、世を正しき
方へ導くため、衆の模範となるよう振る舞い、また世
を乱す悪を率先して撲滅せねばならない。
　かくあればこそ高貴の地位は保証される。

　財権を浪費し遊蕩奢侈に耽るばかりの者も、正義の
戦争を謳い兵を戦地へ送りながら自らは安全な宮殿に
留まる者も、民の畏敬と奉仕を受けるにはあたらない。

　言うなれば家の中に巣食っていた白蟻の群れが駆除
されただけの話なのだから。

The crimson warrior, broadcasting neither shogunate nor occupation identification codes, apparently had an ally. Somebody with one gun was challenging Arahabaki as though the gun were a magic sword.

Still no sight of that person. Probably not the warrior himself. He had watched his colleague's whole fight from a distance: old-generation true-forged tsurugi, long and short swords at the waist, no firearm.

At the changeover his colleague had mentioned other figures near the lift, besides the man who armored up and attacked. Probably one of those.

Now, why appear only now? While the warrior struggled against Arahabaki's plating, the ally had shown nothing. Suddenly this reckless challenge. Why? Not so difficult to work out.

The red unit had taken enormous damage. Enough to fall to its death. Several hits from the Dragon-Qi Cannon—its continued existence was the surprising part.

Abnormally tough, yes. But when Arahabaki's heat ran out, it too had dived and disappeared at the mountain's foot. Reached its limit, almost certainly. No attack during resupply confirmed it.

After that, what? Escape? If it had fled, nothing could be done. This reinforced exterior for dragoons was not built to find and stamp out one infantryman.

But he thought it had stayed. Want to run? Then run on first encountering Arahabaki. Too brave for that? After the Dragon-Qi Cannon, surely the bravery should reconsider.

The enemy could see how slowly this machine moved. Escape was easy enough. Yet it kept fighting.

Who was the warrior? Why come to Enoshima? There had to be a purpose.

That occupation officer who arrived suddenly, took over the institute and started giving orders probably knew. As a career soldier, he had little interest in those irregularities. The details did not matter now.

For its purpose, the enemy had to fight Arahabaki. Therefore this ally had appeared with the pea-shooter.

Why? To buy recovery time for the warrior. Obviously.

Then why BUY time? Why not stay quietly hidden?

The ally attacked first, knowing the gun could do nothing. Why?

—Arahabaki had been too close to the resting, immobile warrior. It had to be drawn away immediately!

So.
Where was the enemy?

Forget the sniper.
Where was the warrior?

Near the place where the first shots came from—

And a soldier willing to challenge Arahabaki with one gun would surely seek the best possible action. Better than best, if possible. In this situation, what should a diversion accomplish?

Prepare an advantage for when the recovered warrior emerged. Place Arahabaki so that its weakness was exposed!

Which weakness? The Dragon-Qi Cannon, as before? No. That would only be another frontal charge.◆

Camouflaged, yes, but after this much fighting the enemy might well have noticed it. The diversion was drawing Arahabaki toward a position where the warrior could strike there.

Apparently pointless guerrilla fire, but a direction existed. This giant was being led somewhere. Achha. Then—

Put it together. All of it.
Where was the enemy's decisive weapon, the warrior, RIGHT NOW!?

短い攻防を経て、彼は事態をほぼ把握した。

　幕軍・進駐軍、いずれの認識信号コードも発信しないあの
深紅色の武者には友軍がいたようだ。
　まるでそれが魔法の剣だと言わんばかりに、銃一挺
を恃たのんでこの荒覇吐アラハバキに無謀な挑戦をする何者か。

　姿はいまだ確認できずにいるが、武者自身ではない
だろう。僚友が乗る荒覇吐と敵武者が戦う様子を彼は
終始遠望していたが、あれは旧代の真打劔冑だった。
　武装は腰に佩はいた大小のみで、銃砲は持たない。

　昇降機リフトの前で遭遇した時、劔冑を装甲して向かって
きた男の他にも人影があった――と、彼と交代する際
に僚友が告げたことを思い出す。
　おそらくは、それだ。

　武者が荒覇吐の甲鉄を前に四苦八苦している間は影
も見せなかったその仲間が、なぜ今になって現れて、
無謀な真似を始めたのか。
　推測を立てるにさしたる苦労は要らない。

　赤色の敵騎が先の交戦で甚大な被害を蒙ったことは
確認している。墜死しても不思議ではない程の。
　数度に渡って竜気砲を浴びているのだから、むしろ
そうならぬ事にこそ首を傾げなくてはならないだろう。

　異常な堅固さと云うべきだが、しかしこちらの熱量
枯渇と時を合わせて敵騎も急降下して山裾に消えたの
は、限界を示すものだったとみてまず間違いない。
　補給中に襲撃を受けなかった事からも確実だ。

　その後、敵騎はどうしたか……
　逃げた、のであれば彼にできる事は何もない。この
竜騎兵用強化外装は一歩兵を探し出して踏み潰すよう
には出来ていない。

　だがそれは無いだろうと彼はみていた。
　逃げるならば荒覇吐と遭遇した瞬間にそうしていれ
ばいい。蛮勇の性さがが邪魔したとしても、竜気砲の洗礼
を受けた後ならば尻尾を巻くだろう。

　こちらの足の鈍さは敵にも見え透いている。
　逃走は容易だと知れていた筈だ。にも拘わらず、彼
は交戦を継続した。

　そもそも敵は何者で、何を求めて、江ノ島へやって
来たのか。
　そう。目的が無い筈はない。

　突如現れるや研究所を掌握し、彼らに命令を下した
進駐軍将校――そのあたりの異変について、職業軍人
たる彼はさして興味を抱いていなかった――は無論、
知っているのだろう。だがこの際それは重要ではない。

　敵は目的の為、この荒覇吐と戦わねばならないのだ。
　だから・・・、友軍が現れて豆鉄砲を撃ち始めたのだ。

　なぜ？
　武者が回復する時間を稼ぐためだ、無論！

　なぜ、稼ぐ・・必要がある？
　黙って潜伏していられなかった理由は？

　敵は先制・・してきた。その銃が一切通用しないと知り
ながら。
　それはなぜか？

　――この荒覇吐と休息中の動けない敵騎が近距離に
あったからだ。
　至急引き離す必要があったのだ！

　ならば。
　敵は何処にいる？

　狙撃兵はどうでもいい。
　武者は何処に潜んでいる？

　最初に銃撃を浴びた場所の付近――

　そして、そう。銃一挺でこの荒覇吐を相手取ろうと
するほどの兵士ならば、常に最善、より最善を求めて
行動することができるはず。
　時間稼ぎを担う兵士の、この状況における最善とは？

　回復を終えた武者が出撃する時のため、武者に有利
な態勢を整えておくことだ――荒覇吐が武者に対して
弱点を見せるような位置関係に持ち込むことだ！

　敵が狙う弱点――先刻のように竜気砲か？
　否。それでは正面特攻も同じ事。◆
　
　……電源ケーブル！

　保護色塗装はされているが、これだけの長時間交戦
したのだ。既に見つけられていても不思議ではない。
　陽動の兵士は武者が其処そこを衝きやすいようにこちら
を誘う！

　敵兵の一見無意味なゲリラ戦術には確かに指向性が
ある。荒覇吐はある方向に導かれている。
　なら。ならば――

　以上を勘案せよ！

左の分も補って騎航姿勢の保持に働いている。

　腕も問題はなかった。左は動かないが、右が健在だ。
尋常の武者と尋常の勝負に臨むのであれば不利は否め
ないが、そんな状況でもない。
　ただ電磁の一刀を揮うのみ。片腕だけで事足りる。

ja.text:
敵騎の挙措からは混乱が窺えた。閃光の一射が飛来
した方角を向き、おそらくは探査機能を働かせながら、
銃砲群の狙いを定めようとしている――◆馬鹿げていた。
もう遅い。今更大尉を仕留めても状況は覆らない。

　本来、それがわからぬ兵士でもないのだろう。
　あの鉄塊の乗り手は――しかし、ケーブルと諸共に
心の緒まで断ち切られていたか。

　一瞬前、死の瀬戸際に立たされていた筈の俺が今、
駆け抜けるのは敵騎の致命的な隙へ直進する一線。
　見えている。先刻確認した、仕手の搭乗位置！

　にも拘わらず迎撃はない。
　異形の巨人は己おのがアキレス腱を切り裂いた何者かに
意識を奪われている。危急の状勢を看過している。

　最大の好機。
　ここで、決めねば――――
